name: cf-company-formation
description: Use this Central African Republic formation Guide for 2026 research on SARL and SA capital, subscription, payment, registration and ordinary annual reporting. It separates OHADA uniform-act defaults from national formalities, and maps the published GUFE dossier route without promising a statutory processing time. Search triggers include RCCM, NIU, NIF, SARL capital, SA capital, incorporation, share subscription and annual accounts. Tax filing and fiscal visa obligations are routed to their own Guide. The national capital-override check, exact fees, local supporting forms and current filing channels remain unresolved. This is a source-based partial draft, not registration advice for an identified company.
